description: Find an issue by text in its title or culprit, across every issue the app has. Use it when you know the error message, exception type or function. Same filters and rows as list_error_issues.

environment.description: Issues with an event in this environment

include_console.description: Also list console lines from the app (default false)

include_legacy.description: Also list issues grouped before grouping v2 (default false)

include_spark.description: Add a 14-day sparkline per row (default false)

query.description: Text to look for in the title or culprit

release.description: Text in a release the issue was seen in

since.description: Last seen since: an ISO time, or 30m, 24h, 7d

sort.description: Default last_seen. new = first seen most recently

source.description: The server, the app, or both (default all)

name: search_error_issues
title: Search error issues
